t: Arthur: D.W. Tale Spins/Prunella Gets It Twice
st: D.W. Tale Spins/Prunella Gets It Twice
d: What happens when you combine Greek Mythology with D.W.'s imagination? Then, getting two Polly Locket dolls almost ruins Prunella's birthday party. That, and Francine's bad mood--why, she wouldn't even sing the Happy Birthday song!

t: Arthur: The Blackout/Mei Lin Takes a Stand
st: The Blackout/Mei Lin Takes a Stand
d: It's a hot day in Elwood City, and a total blackout leaves its residents without electricity! Will Arthur and DW survive without AC and TV? Binky's baby sister Mei-Lin isn't keen on learning to walk and would rather stick to crawling.

t: Arthur: Arthur Babysits/Arthur's Cousin Catastrophe
st: Arthur Babysits/Arthur's Cousin Catastrophe
d: You think running a marathon is hard? Try babysitting for the Terrible Tibble Twins. Next, Arthur's family is hosting the once-a-year-is-more-than-enough family reunion. But a major thunderstorm turns this into a reunion to remember.

t: Arthur: The Butler Did...What?/The Trouble with Trophies
st: The Butler Did...What?/The Trouble with Trophies
d: Bailey is missing! Muffy discovers a series of clues and is left wondering, who exactly IS Bailey? Then, everyone loves getting trophies, right? It turns out that Fern could not care less about them.

t: Arthur: Arthur's Numbers Nightmare/Brain Gets Hooked
st: Arthur's Numbers Nightmare/Brain Gets Hooked
d: When the gang discovers a list of their class rankings in Principal Haney's office, they are all taken for a surprise. Brain gets hooked on the latest tween reality show and then starts to ignore his friends and his schoolwork.

t: Arthur: What Is That Thing?/Buster's Best Behavior
st: What Is That Thing?/Buster's Best Behavior
d: Arthur and friends are all faced with seemingly impossible tasks, from fixing a model biplane to babysitting D.W. And, Buster knows he's fun, but he's beginning to feel like he's not particularly good at anything.

t: Arthur: Arthur and The Crunch Cereal Contest/D.W. Flips
st: Arthur and The Crunch Cereal Contest/D.W. Flips
d: A year's supply of Crunch Cereal is in store for the person who can write the new Crunch Cereal jingle, and Arthur is sure he can do it. Next, how hard can it be to do a cartwheel on a balance beam? D.W. is about to find out.

t: Arthur: Flippity Francine/Muffy Takes the Wheel
st: Flippity Francine/Muffy Takes the Wheel
d: When Muffy posts a goofy video of Francine on the Muffington Post, Francine worries she will become the laughing stock of the entire school. And it's the 1st Annual Lakewood Derby and Muffy's revved up!

t: Arthur: Francine's Split Decision/Muffy Goes Metropolitan
st: Francine's Split Decision/Muffy Goes Metropolitan
d: Lakewood Elementary is sure to win the big bowling tournament on Saturday, but Francine's cousin is having his Bar Mitzvah at the same time! Muffy happily accepts an invitation to spend the weekend in the bustling Crown City.

t: Arthur: Whip. Mix. Blend./Staycation
st: Whip. Mix. Blend./Staycation
d: When Rattles's mom starts dating Archie Vanderloo, Rattles finds himself spending time with his twins, but they don’t have anything in common. Arthur offers to babysit so that his parents can enjoy some peace and quiet in the backyard.

t: Arthur: Best Wishes/The Tardy Tumbler
st: Best Wishes/The Tardy Tumbler
d: After George has a lucky streak, his friends pressure him to wish for a snow day. Can George deliver? Prunella's excited about making the gymnastics team, until she realizes practice starts at 6am! Will she practice or snooze?

t: Arthur: Locked In The Library!/Arthur Accused!
st: Locked In The Library!/Arthur Accused!
d: Arthur and Francine are fighting. But when they get locked inside the library they either have to make up or prepare for a long evening. And when Buster opens his detective agency, he has no idea his first job will involve Arthur.

t: Arthur: The Perfect Game/D.W.'s Furry Freakout
st: The Perfect Game/D.W.'s Furry Freakout
d: Francine is excited about a school project, but she's so obsessed with making it perfect that she can't seem to get anything done at all. When D.W. finds a stray kitten, it soon turns out to be a lot more than D.W. can handle.

t: Arthur: D.W.'s Time Trouble/Buster's Amish Mismatch
st: D.W.'s Time Trouble/Buster's Amish Mismatch
d: D.W. is tired of being bossed around all the time and demands to know why she couldn't have been born before Arthur! And during a trip to Amish country, Buster becomes enamored with the simple life and vows to forgo modern conveniences.

t: Arthur: Feeling Flush/Family Fortune
st: Feeling Flush/Family Fortune
d: During a drought, Francine bets Arthur that her family can use less water than his. The TV show, Treasure Caravan, is coming to Elwood City! Arthur and D.W. are convinced they'll find treasures that will make them rich and famous.

t: Arthur: Prunella's Special Edition/The Secret Life Of Dogs & Babies
st: Prunella's Special Edition/The Secret Life Of Dogs & Babies
d: The latest book about everyone's favorite boy wizard--Henry Skreever--is finally out! Every kid in town is lining up to get it, except Prunella, who's ordered a limited edition from England. Ever wonder what Baby Kate and Pal are thinking?

t: Arthur: The Lousy Week/You Are Arthur
st: The Lousy Week/You Are Arthur
d: An army of lice has descended on the heads of Lakewood Elementary. Who or what is strong enough to defeat them? What if you could be Arthur for a day? View Arthur's life through his very own eyes for this special episode.

t: Arthur: The Curse of the Grebes/Arthur Changes Gears
st: The Curse of the Grebes/Arthur Changes Gears
d: The Elwood City Grebes haven't won the Baseball Championship since 1918. But with the addition of three players, the title is finally within reach. Arthur finally saves enough money to buy the bike of his dreams!

t: Arthur: Buster's Secret Admirer/The Last King of Lambland
st: Buster's Secret Admirer/The Last King of Lambland
d: Buster receives a box of chocolates in the mail from a secret admirer. It's driving him crazy! Who could possibly like him that much? And James receives a gift from his uncle in Scotland--a toy lamb that will give its owner special powers!

t: Arthur: War of the Worms/I Owe You One
st: War of the Worms/I Owe You One
d: Brain is always taking the fun out of Fern's storytelling by correcting her facts, but things gets out of hand when Fern tricks him with a fake story! Buster is always asking for favors. Will he learn the real meaning of friendship?

t: Arthur: Double Tibble Trouble/Arthur's Almost Live Not Real Music Festival
st: Double Tibble Trouble/Arthur's Almost Live Not Real Music Festival
d: Playing with the Tibble twins requires preparation, endurance and earplugs. But when one gets sick, playing with the other should be a lot easier, right? Arthur and the gang create their own music videos.

t: Arthur: Arthur vs. The Very Mean Crossing Guard/D.W.'s Very Bad Mood
st: Arthur vs. The Very Mean Crossing Guard/D.W.'s Very Bad Mood
d: Arthur and The Brain encounter a new crossing guard on the way home from school. This guard isn't just mean, he's nuts! And, D.W. is making Arthur's life miserable! Francine decides she'd fix D.W.'s behavior before Arthur loses his mind.

t: Arthur: The Last of Mary Moo Cow/Bitzi's Beau
st: The Last of Mary Moo Cow/Bitzi's Beau
d: When Mary Moo Cow is cancelled, D.W. is devastated. How can television--or life as she knows it--ever be the same? Buster hasn't yet met Bitzi's new boyfriend, but he fears the worst. What if he is a Mom-stealer?

t: Arthur: Sue Ellen Gets Her Goose Cooked/Best of The Nest
st: Sue Ellen Gets Her Goose Cooked/Best of The Nest
d: Sue Ellen is the champion of the popular Internet game, Virtualgoose.com, but she’s become obsessed! And now the gang has moved onto Best of the Nest. Will any of his friends be willing to forgo their computers for a real, live adventure?

t: Arthur: Francine's Pilfered Paper/Buster Gets Real
st: Francine's Pilfered Paper/Buster Gets Real
d: When Francine has a big paper over Thanksgiving, she copies from a website. There's nothing wrong with that, is there? Everyone loves the new Top Supermarket reality series on TV, except Arthur. Will it end his friendship with Buster?

t: Arthur: Listen Up!/Arthur's New Old Vacation
st: Listen Up!/Arthur's New Old Vacation
d: When Francine's Bubbe passes away, Muffy tries to understand how she can help her friend. Then, when Arthur's family goes on the same vacation they take every year, he and Buster try to make it more exciting.

t: Arthur: Happy Anniversary
st: Happy Anniversary
d: Arthur's parents have been married for 10 years and it's time to celebrate! But the festivities are cut short when the van breaks down, stranding the whole family. Will the Reads miss their fancy dinner reservation?

t: Arthur: Arthur and The Real Mr. Ratburn/Arthur's Spelling Trubble
st: Arthur and The Real Mr. Ratburn/Arthur's Spelling Trubble
d: It's the first day of third grade and Arthur's biggest fear has come true--his new teacher is the dreaded Mr. Ratburn. Then, it’s time for the all-school spellathon. Arthur is chosen to compete, and he finds facing Prunella and The Brain!

t: Arthur: Night of the Tibble/Read and Flumberghast
st: Night of the Tibble/Read and Flumberghast
d: The Tibble Twins are having their first sleepover! Will the Tibbles lock James in the dark basement? Then, a cupcake's been stolen! The primary suspect: Tommy Tibble. D.W. gathers a jury and demands that justice be served.

t: Arthur: Room to Ride/The Frensky Family Fiasco
st: Room to Ride/The Frensky Family Fiasco
d: With Lance Armstrong’s support, Binky and his friends take to the streets to convince residents to vote for new bike safety lanes. Francine wants the Frenskys to be closer, but a weekly Family Night turns out to be harder than expected.

t: Arthur: Arthur Goes To Camp/Buster Makes The Grade
st: Arthur Goes To Camp/Buster Makes The Grade
d: Arthur and his friends go to summer camp where it's strictly boys vs. girls. Next, Buster Baxter is everyone's favorite jokester. Unfortunately, though, Buster's grades aren't as good as his jokes, and Buster may have to repeat third grade.

t: Arthur: The Great MacGrady, Parts 1 & 2
st: The Great MacGrady, Parts 1 & 2
d: When Mrs. MacGrady is diagnosed with cancer, Arthur and his friends all react differently to the news. The kids must learn how to come together to help support each other and Mrs. MacGrady.

t: Arthur: Arthur's Treasure Hunt/The Return Of The King
st: Arthur's Treasure Hunt/The Return Of The King
d: When Buster digs up an ancient arrowhead, everyone else wants to hunt for buried treasures, too. And a field trip to the Medieval Fair pits Arthur's class against another led by Ratburn's super-tough mentor, Mr. Pryce-Jones.
